name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Threat Prediction Neural Network
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Threat Prediction Neural Network
description: An AI system that analyzes patterns in security data — incident reports, surveillance feeds, weapons purchases, communications metadata, and movement patterns — to predict security threats before they materialize. The TPNN identifies the preparatory indicators of attacks, sabotage, and espionage operations, flagging developing threats an average of 48 hours before execution. Arcturus deploys the system for their own facility defense and sells it as a service to corporate clients, providing threat advisories that allow pre-emptive countermeasures.
social_impact: The TPNN has enabled a shift from reactive to pre-emptive security that raises fundamental questions about due process and presumption of innocence. When a system predicts that someone will commit an act of violence, acting on that prediction before the act occurs means punishing intention rather than action. Arcturus argues that prevention is always preferable to response; civil liberties advocates argue that prediction-based intervention is indistinguishable from thought policing.
story_hooks: The TPNN has predicted a major attack with 92% confidence — but the predicted perpetrator is a loyal corporate employee with no history of violence, and intervening based on prediction alone would ruin an innocent person's life if the model is wrong.
The TPNN has stopped making predictions for a specific geographic area — not because the area is safe, but because the data feeding the model from that area is being systematically falsified.
